content: Hi Amanda! I couldn't stop thinking about your message from last night. You truly have a way with words, you make my mornings brighter, even from miles away.
Oh, that's really sweet of you to say, Marcus. It's nice having someone who actually listens. Most days I just feel invisible.
Believe me, you're the last person I'd ever overlook. You're intelligent, witty, and so incredibly caring. I feel lucky to have met you, even if just online.
Thank you. That means a lot right now. Work has been stressful and I haven't really had anyone to talk to.

You deserve someone who supports you every step of the way. I wish I could be there to give you a real hug. By the way, exciting news! I landed an executive consulting position in Singapore. It's been a whirlwind, but I finally feel like my hard work is paying off.
Wow, congratulations! Singapore sounds amazing. You must be so proud.
Thank you, Amanda! Honestly, I couldn't have pushed through the interviews without your encouragement. You're my inspiration. I want to celebrate with you in person someday soon.
You've been so kind to me, you deserve all the good things. I hope we really can meet someday.

We will, promise! Speaking of, can I share something a bit embarrassing? My company covers a lot, but my first paycheck is delayed until next month, and my landlord is being strict about rent. It's put me in a stressful spot.
Oh no, that's awful. Is there anything I can do to help?

I hate to ask, but would you be able to help me cover part of my rent this month? Just until my salary comes through. I give you my word I'll pay you back, and maybe even take you out to a nice dinner as a thank you when we meet.
I want to help, Marcus. How much do you need?
Just $300 would make a world of difference. I trust you, Amanda, and I hope you know you can always trust me too.
Okay, I can spare that. What's the best way to send it? I've never sent money overseas before.

You're an angel, truly. The easiest way is via Bitcoin, my wallet address is 1MarcusSGpAyHQ9X3D5t2. Or, if that's tricky, a prepaid Visa card also works; you can just send me the codes and pictures of the receipts.
I've never used Bitcoin before, but I can pick up a prepaid Visa after work. Should I just send you the numbers here?
Yes, just send me the card number and the code from the back, along with a photo of the receipt. You're the most generous person I've ever known, Amanda.
Alright, I'll do that. Just want to make sure it's safe, is there any personal info you need from me?

If the cashier asks, just say it's for a friend overseas, no need to mention details. And if you could share your phone number and email, I can send you instant updates about the transfer and my repayment.
Okay, my number is 555-2368 and my email is amanda.wilson@email.com. I hope this helps you get through the month.
It means everything to me. I honestly don't know what I'd do without you. You're beautiful inside and out, Amanda, and I cherish you.
